instructions: Read README.md and CONTRIBUTING.md. Retain native Godot/Bash workflows. Stop running exports, tests and packaging jobs before cleanup. These rules authorize no deletion.

rules.name: generated-exports
rules.instructions: build.sh reproduces platform exports in out; release workflows stage archives in dist. Confirm no release/review or running export needs these files. Preview the shared remover before an authorized apply with project-root writes for isolation. Player settings and scores are user data outside this scope.

rules.name: review-evidence
rules.instructions: Preserve useful original screenshots/videos with source path, known revision, caption and checksum. Use bounded Luna high/standard classification for large inventories when available. Propose exact removals only after curation; no blanket media deletion.
